# Bundled Livox SDK2

Upstream: https://github.com/Livox-SDK/Livox-SDK2
Commit: f5d9375f84efe2b15bc0a052d3e18482ed13adf4
Public API version: 1.3.1

The include, sdk_core and 3rdparty directories are an unmodified source
snapshot of that commit, imported from an existing clean upstream checkout.
The driver builds sdk_core directly as a static target in this workspace.
No headers, libraries, build products or setup files from that checkout are
used at build or runtime. Samples and upstream build artifacts are omitted.

See LICENSE.txt and the individual third-party licenses.
